target.title: fix(qa-lab): prevent Slack desktop bootstrap hangs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QA Lab Slack desktop smoke runs could wait indefinitely while fetching the NodeSource setup script, Node.js checksum or archive, or the pnpm archive.

## Why This Change Was Made

The generated remote script now gives all four downloads a 10-second connection deadline and a 120-second total deadline. The verified Node.js and pnpm artifact downloads preserve their existing three finite retries, while the piped NodeSource script intentionally is not retried because replaying a partially emitted script into `bash` is unsafe. The existing Slack `auth.test` request remains bounded by its 15-second `AbortSignal.timeout` deadline.

## User Impact

QA operators now get a finite, logged bootstrap failure instead of a Slack desktop smoke run remaining stuck in a download.

## Evidence

- Exact head: `a1c1de28ce6de0ba66aff6f8250a8a28adcf80ff`, rebased without patch changes onto `3e4b3b370f944f3e22c5104cd7d78c955fef8b2d`; the touched files are unchanged through current `main` at `b6989cbaf26ec35154d259f0e861d064477f3826`.
- Generated-script assertions lock all four curl targets and deadlines, the three existing archive retry policies, and the existing `AbortSignal.timeout(15_000)` call.
- Secretless live NodeSource probe returned HTTP 200 in 0.70s. [NodeSource distributions](https://github.com/nodesource/distributions)
- Secretless live Node.js `v24.15.0` checksum probe returned HTTP 200 in 0.74s. [Node.js release files](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.15.0/)
- Secretless live pnpm `11.2.2` tarball probe returned HTTP 200 in 1.20s. [pnpm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pnpm)
- Secretless Slack `auth.test` probe without a token returned HTTP 200 with `not_authed`; no credential was used or printed. [Slack auth.test](https://api.slack.com/methods/auth.test)
- Controlled no-response curl calibration with `--max-time 1` exited 28 after 1,012 ms.
- `oxfmt --check` passed for both touched files; `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Fresh Claude Sonnet autoreview: patch correct, confidence 0.95, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Secretless fork [CI run 29400924097](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29400924097) passed: 50 jobs succeeded and 12 out-of-scope jobs skipped.
- [CodeQL run 29400923917](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29400923917) passed all 7 security jobs; [Critical Quality run 29400923980](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29400923980) passed its 2 selected jobs and skipped 14 out-of-scope jobs.
- AI-assisted: implemented with Codex and reviewed with Claude. I inspected and understand the generated-script behavior.

The curl deadline semantics follow the [official curl man page](https://curl.se/docs/manpage.html).
